title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 AliasMode Chain Resolution Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, diff hygiene, and full local Release solution test for RFC 9461 AliasMode chain resolution.
scope: This verification covers AliasMode RDATA parsing for priority zero and uncompressed TargetName with no SvcParams, deterministic owner-to-target chain traversal to ServiceMode records, explicit loop reporting, explicit missing-target reporting, and malformed AliasMode RDATA rejection for short data, ServiceMode priority, compressed target names, and AliasMode records carrying SvcParams.
preconditions: The RFC 9461 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9461.json`.
ServiceMode SVCB RDATA parsing remains owned by `REQ-QUIC-RFC9461-0039` and `DnsServiceBindingWireRecord.ParseServiceModeRData`.
procedure: Run `dotnet test Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` before final goal completion.
expected_result: The focused requirement-home tests pass, the DNS project builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9461 artifacts, generated triage reports the new requirement as trace-clean, diff hygiene passes, and the full local Release solution test suite remains green before final goal completion.
status_summary: The RFC 9461 AliasMode chain-resolution primitive is trace-owned and verified. Full DNS message parsing, Additional-section processing, DNSSEC, operator publication, host resolver installation, and encrypted DNS session establishment remain future adapter work.
